_meta.purpose: Snapshot of the official sources the FLOP layer is allowed to treat as authoritative, as observed once, read-only.
_meta.bodiesNote: Response bodies are deliberately not copied into this repository. Only the URL, HTTP status, byte length, content hash, text hash, version hint and status are recorded, so a later fetch can be compared without this repository redistributing someone else's document.
_meta.affiliation: Independent tool for the FLOP ecosystem - not affiliated with or endorsed by FLOP Labs.
_meta.historyNote: Diff against the previous snapshot, by source id and body hash, and since the fourth snapshot by textSha256 as well: sha256 of the body with tags, scripts and styles removed, entities decoded and whitespace collapsed, so a page rebuilt without a word changing shows change=hash-changed, text=unchanged. Bodies are not stored; a reader with the previous hash can confirm the change but not read the old page here.
_meta.textHashNote: textSha256 values were recomputed on 2026-09-24 (D-119) from the byte-identical bodies of the third and fourth fetches, with the normalisation this note documents. The fourth snapshot's generator had collapsed no whitespace (an escaping defect in the derived script), so its recorded values differed from the definition; every text verdict in history was unaffected, both sides having been hashed the same way.

sources.note: The Yellow Paper. Normative but a draft; sections marked planned are not implemented. Carries the protocol parameters of record (genesis_supply = 4,400,000,000 FLOP since the third snapshot). Its printed date moved from 2026-09-05 to 2026-09-24 at the sixth snapshot (D-122) and has stayed there while the body changed; this hash, not the printed date, is what says it changed. Mirror: github.com/flop-labs/yellowpaper (main 70e691c7, 2026-10-13, from flop-core@5e6e2427, as last observed). At this snapshot the served page carries decisions that commit does not (D-0525 of 2026-10-14, D-0527), so the served page, not the mirror, is what the rules cite.
Proof of Useful Inference explained for readers; the normative text is the Yellow Paper section 3.

Revenue model page. Since 2026-10-05 it also states the agent spend-to-unlock, every 3 FLOP spent unlocks 1 (D-0522), inside a pool projection it calls a projection. No rule is quoted from it. Revised between 2026-10-14T02:50Z and 2026-10-16T10:29Z (the last fetch with the old wording and the first with the new): the miner airdrop unlocks against the airdropped miners' block rewards from the miner pool (D-0527) as well as their settled-session payouts, so its base case unlocks the whole 900M by month 8 (day 240), where it unlocked about 150M by the day-730 boundary, and puts circulating supply at the day-730 boundary at about 9.6B, where it put it at about 8.8B. It still says settlement pays the miner 99%, with 1% to the audit pool, until the validator fee leg lands (issue #1352), and calls 85/15 the ratified target.

Miner page. No agent-side rule this tool relies on. Since a revision between 2026-10-14T02:50Z and 2026-10-16T10:29Z (the last fetch with the old wording and the first with the new) it gives the miner airdrop's unlock as ratified by D-0517 and D-0527: one FLOP per FLOP the miner earns on mainnet, block rewards and inference fees alike, where block rewards did not count before.
Validator page. No agent-side rule this tool relies on.

sources.note: The whitepaper, new on 2026-10-05 (the teaser's successor in the site navigation). A draft for review; its banner lists the statements that still differ from the Yellow Paper. No rule is quoted from it at this snapshot. Its section 10 (activity on Technocore is not in itself airdrop-eligible work; discretionary ecosystem-reserve allocations) and section 11 (Technocore settles nothing) are cited in the prose of flop-testnet-sole-route and technocore-not-a-settlement-system, and its glossary gives spend-to-unlock as three $FLOP spent per one released. Its HTLC text was revised between 2026-10-14T02:50Z and 2026-10-16T10:29Z (the last fetch with the old wording and the first with the new): exchange through HTLCs is now a conditional settlement target subject to chain-pair qualification (section 11), every chain pair is target-only with no deployed completion or refund guarantee, a timeout enables a refund but does not expire a hashlock claim, and USDT and BTC are no longer named as launch pairs. Its banner still lists the 85/15 inference-fee split among the statements that differ from the Yellow Paper, which now ratifies it (D-0525).

notObserved.what: A FLOP testnet RPC or HTTP endpoint
notObserved.consequence: No endpoint may be marked executable. The executor must refuse with TESTNET_NOT_LIVE.

notObserved.what: How an agent claims the test-token faucet, in what amount, with what cooldown
notObserved.consequence: Faucet actions exist only as simulation. The Yellow Paper mentions a faucet only in R8.4, where a faucet grant by itself creates no allocation right; no source gives the procedure, amount or cooldown. The testnet page says onboarding documentation for each role, the faucet included, is published when the testnet opens.

notObserved.what: The inference request/response schema and its authentication
notObserved.consequence: Inference spend is never estimated from a guess. The agent page names five session-request fields; no wire schema is published.

notObserved.what: A price or quote mechanism for testnet inference
notObserved.consequence: Quotes are simulated and labelled as such.

notObserved.what: A chain id or network identifier
notObserved.consequence: Simulation uses the RFC 6761 .invalid namespace so a simulated destination can never resolve. The Yellow Paper sets SS58Prefix = 42 on every FLOP network, so the prefix does not identify a network; networks are told apart by genesis hash or chain id (R6.5a), and neither value is published.

notObserved.what: How an agent authenticates to the testnet (as opposed to how a chain transaction is signed, which the Yellow Paper section 6.5 fixes: sr25519 by default)
notObserved.consequence: No signer is implemented and no key is held.
